description: 50 x 10 mm carrier on a tabletop demonstrator with a vertical mounting panel. Carrier centre P and directed long axis are the tool frame.
mapping: physical_xy_mm = normalized_xy * 30 + [250,40]; lengths multiply by 30; angles and S_ratio unchanged.
panel_screen: Post-search check of link centreline endpoints and all four carrier corners over 7201 input phases. Ground pivots require 10 mm edge clearance. Not a solver-enforced constraint or collision check.
scope: Three target poses and full-cycle kinematic assembly. No specified cycle duration, dwell, payload, torque, structure, bearing clearance, collision avoidance, continuous levelness, or manufactured tolerances.
